question: Which of the following soils is found in areas of heavy rainfall and high humidity?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Peaty soil.**__

__
 
• **Peaty soil is found in areas of heavy rainfall and high humidity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 **Soil**
 **Details**
 
 

 Yellow soil
 
 
 
• It is formed under broad leaves in humid** subtropical regions.**
 
• Its yellow colour is due to ferric oxide
 
• It has an acid reaction and low humus content.
 
• Mainly found in Odisha and Chhattisgarh regions.
 
 
 
 

 Red soil 
 
 
 
• It develops in warm, temperate and humid climates.
 
• It contains thin organic mineral layers of highly leached soil resting on a red layer of alluvium
 
• Mainly found in Odisha and Chhattisgarh regions.
 
 
 
 

 Saline soil
 
 
 
• It contains a lower amount of Na adsorbed onto soil particles.
 
• They exist in arid and semi-arid regions in the regions of poor natural drainage
 
• It occurs in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Orissa, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Haryana, Gujarat
 
 
 
 

 Peat soil
 
 
 
• It has a high water-holding capacity, high natural moisture content.
 
• It occurs in the northern part of Bihar, Southern part of Uttranchal, coastal areas of West Bengal, Orissa, Tamil Nadu
